intent: Create a square launch image for a handcrafted jasmine-tea tin that feels tactile, giftable, and contemporary rather than rustic or synthetic.

creative_routing.audience_effect: make the tea feel carefully made, calm, modern, and giftable
creative_routing.design_priority: tin silhouette, label readability, paper tactility, and believable contact
creative_routing.cultural_context: contemporary tea craft without invented heritage symbols
creative_routing.mix_rule: stop-motion craft controls the object and miniature set; editorial spacing controls only hierarchy and negative space
creative_routing.adaptation_rule: the learned graphite/copper hierarchy may influence finish, but the tea tin, paper craft, square composition, and green identity remain authoritative

scene.summary: A single jasmine-tea tin rests inside a minimal folded-paper garden.
scene.setting: small studio tabletop with layered paper leaves and one low paper plinth

subjects.description: one cylindrical matte ivory jasmine-tea tin with a blank dark-green paper label and one small abstract jasmine relief, no lettering
subjects.action: rests firmly on the paper plinth
subjects.pose: upright with the label facing camera
subjects.scale: occupies about forty percent of frame height
relationships: paper leaves frame the tin without touching the label

spatial_dynamics.dominant_read: one tactile tea tin with a fully readable silhouette and label plane
spatial_dynamics.secondary_read: folded paper leaves reveal craft through layered shadows
spatial_dynamics.beauty_mechanism: matte ivory and deep green separate against graphite, with one narrow copper lid accent and generous quiet space
spatial_dynamics.tension_source: restrained asymmetry between centered product mass and sweeping paper leaves
spatial_dynamics.realism_anchor: contact shadow, paper fiber, metal seam, and accurate cylinder perspective
spatial_dynamics.action_vector: paper leaves rise diagonally around a stable vertical product
spatial_dynamics.counterforce: the low plinth and circular tin keep the composition grounded
spatial_dynamics.foreground_role: one soft leaf edge provides depth without covering the product
spatial_dynamics.midground_role: tea tin owns product identity and material proof
spatial_dynamics.background_role: graphite field provides copy-safe calm and tonal separation
spatial_dynamics.depth_transition: foreground leaf to tin edge to quiet background
spatial_dynamics.parallax_logic: small near paper overlap, stable product plane, soft distant field
spatial_dynamics.readability_guard: do not distort the cylinder, label plane, lid ellipse, or product contact

composition.framing: single centered hero with asymmetrical paper leaves and generous upper-right negative space
composition.negative_space: clean upper-right field for optional external copy

lighting.summary: one large soft key and a restrained warm edge reflection
lighting.key: large diffused source from upper left reveals paper grain and cylinder form
lighting.fill: minimal graphite bounce preserves readable dark values
lighting.rim: narrow warm reflection only on the lid edge
lighting.contrast: soft product contrast with contained highlights
lighting.color_temperature: neutral key with a subtle warm edge

materials.description: matte coated metal, uncoated label paper, and layered cut paper
materials.microstructure: fine uncoated paper fiber and subtle sprayed-metal texture
materials.roughness: high on paper and coated body; medium-low only on the copper lid edge
materials.specular_response: broad soft body highlight and one narrow controlled copper reflection
materials.transmission: paper leaves remain opaque with slight edge translucency only
materials.subsurface_behavior: very low paper-fiber light penetration at thin edges
materials.anisotropy: subtle brushed direction on the copper lid ring
materials.wear_patina: new product with tiny hand-finished seam variation, no grime
materials.contact_deformation: paper leaves bend at folds and the tin compresses the plinth shadow without floating

style.medium: physical stop-motion product set rendered as a polished still photograph

render_pipeline.lighting_transport: soft diffuse and glossy path-traced product lighting with limited transmission through paper edges
render_pipeline.global_illumination: clean multi-bounce studio fill with restrained green and copper color bleed
render_pipeline.ray_tracing: roughness-aware reflections and accurate contact visibility
render_pipeline.reflection_model: broad dielectric highlights on coated metal and paper, narrow anisotropic copper edge
render_pipeline.shadow_model: soft area shadows plus precise layered-paper contact shadows
render_pipeline.ambient_occlusion: local only inside paper folds, beneath the tin, and at material seams
render_pipeline.transmission_refraction: no glass; paper edge translucency remains subtle
render_pipeline.displacement_normal: micro-normal paper tooth and sprayed-metal texture; no noisy displacement
render_pipeline.texture_scale: fine texture resolves only on the product and nearest paper
render_pipeline.sampling_denoise: high samples with label-edge and paper-fiber-preserving denoise
render_pipeline.npr_strategy: physical paper-craft construction remains visible without cartoon outlines

quality_controls: matte surfaces retain fine texture without sharpening halos
